title: Insecure permissions in the feiertage.ImportActivity component of Arbeitszeiterfassung2 versionCode 159 allows…
description: An insecure permission vulnerability exists in the feiertage.ImportActivity component of Arbeitszeiterfassung2 versionCode 159. This flaw allows unauthorized attackers to create forged holiday or work-time entries by importing specially crafted ICS files.
